headline: N-central exploits work on patched servers; ScreenConnect plugin flaw spreads malware; GPUStack auth bypass under attack

bullets.text: New: The Hacker News reports new N-central exploits that work against patched servers, giving root RCE and Windows SYSTEM access. This follows attacks on N-central zero-days as N-able rushed patches (3 outlets).

New: The Register reports a ScreenConnect plugin flaw being exploited to spread malware across hundreds of PCs. Earlier rogue-client attacks hit at least 288 endpoints across 48 organizations and breached MSPs (5 outlets).

SANS ISC sees exploit attempts against the GPUStack authentication bypass CVE-2026-102895. KEV due today (11-12), along with OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets) and Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. Due 11-24: Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350, Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320.

Notion customer data was compromised in the Fireworks AI hack (6 outlets). Separately, 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts ran a CI secret stealer in 1,806+ repos. PTC patched critical Windchill/FlexPLM RCE CVE-2026-126325.
Also on the board: Xen Orchestra flaws exploited; Apache HTTP/2 RCE CVE-2026-119618; Maersk data theft; Vanderbilt ransomware lockdown (6 outlets). SITCON 3 holds at 1.07x the 90-day average.

actions: N-central: do not rely on patches alone; take consoles off the internet now and hunt for root or SYSTEM-level compromise on N-central hosts.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and plugins, remove unknown clients and plugins, and hunt for malware pushed through remote sessions.
GPUStack, OpenSSH, FreeSwitch and Aspera Faspex KEV fixes are due today; take exposed GPUStack servers offline until patched.
Patch Barracuda ESG and Ivanti Connect Secure by 11-13; schedule Outlook, Chromium and Cisco BroadWorks fixes before 11-24.
Rotate CI secrets in repos with unfamiliar workflow runs; review data sent through Fireworks AI or Notion AI.
Patch PTC Windchill/FlexPLM for CVE-2026-126325 and keep Xen Orchestra and Apache HTTP/2 hosts off the open internet.
